questions.question: Explain the difference between backpressure and pipeline utility in Node.js.
questions.ideal_answer: backpressure and pipeline utility differ in several ways: backpressure is flow control mechanism (works by preventing memory overflow) whereas pipeline utility is stream error handling (works by graceful stream chaining). backpressure is typically used for readable.pause(), writable.write() return value, while pipeline utility is used for automatic cleanup on error. Example demonstrating backpressure: pipeline(src, transform, dest, callback);. Example demonstrating pipeline utility: const { pipeline } = require('stream');.
